text_block_list.text: As I'm walking back to my office during my lunch break…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, King's trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, you've come at just the right time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I know it's lunchtime, but can we borrow your office?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There's a quiz coming up, and we want to study for it, but…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, there are no study spaces available at the moment.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: For that reason, I hereby grant you the right to lend your room out to me and my associate!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Excellent, this place is perfect for my studies. A splendid idea, if I do say so myself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Right then, let's work hard to overcome our weaker subjects!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sounds good to me! ♪
choice_data_list: Thank you for looking out for King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ahem! And what do you mean by that? You should be thanking me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Grass requested my assistance!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm a little unsure about certain aspects of applied math, so King is tutoring me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's true that Grass does have excellent grades and doesn't seem the type to need tutoring…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But my grades are top class as well! I'm first-rate both in and out of the classroom!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's true that King is truly a cut above.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: She always gets good grades on tests and is regarded highly by all the teachers.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But what's most impressive is her ability to meet difficult problems head-on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! You flatter me! But of course, it's the truth!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, do you see now? I'm quite capable of holding my own against Grass!
choice_data_list: You two are rivals even when it comes to studying, huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Whether it's studying or racing, we're opponents who drive each other to greater heights!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Come along, Grass! We must set our sights on becoming first-rate Umamusume together, then spread our wings as a first-rate duo!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hm? Spread our wings… as a duo?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It'll be fine! We can pioneer an all-new act! A first-rate one, of course! Ohohoho!
As respectful rivals, the pair drive each other to improve at both racing and studying.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ngh! G-Grass…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Grass may have won this time… But the next quiz is mine!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, then I had better not let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I'll show you what a royal comeback looks like!
Although fiercely competitive, the two end up being splendid study buddies.
